{{Top|leg}}
'''Urchins''' were [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] yellow [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] that, when touched or plucked, would writhe violently and hurl their long, purplish needles (quills) at any perceived attacker. The needles also hung from globs at the flower's roots, and if the plant was uprooted, the quill-glob would slap at an attacker like a ball on a string.

[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] kept many of these hurtful meadow flowers (as she did other [[:Category:Predatory creatures|predatory]] [[:Category:Carnivorous plants|plants]] and [[:Category:Carnivorous creatures|animals]]) in the [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] of her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]], near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. She took twisted delight when unwary [[Slavery/Legends|captive beings]], constrained to enter the garden for her own and others' perverse entertainment, happened upon an urchin, then stooped to pluck it from its stem (or worse, the full urchin plant). In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the bumbling [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] cyclops giant [[Gondry]], while [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends#Gardulla's revenge|in pursuit of escaped slaves]], was one of these unfortunate beings; after plucking an urchin handful, he yelled 'Stupid flowers!' and spent the next long while sitting cross-legged, pulling purple quills from his foot.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>
